name: Index Studio
description: An independent design practice with an editorial masthead, twelve original project panels, contact-sheet browsing and a selectable inquiry flow.

notes.layout: oversized masthead, angled project artifacts, dark contact-sheet archive, discipline filters, four full case studies, studio and inquiry pages
